vo: You budgeted thirty-one thousand. The bill says forty-eight.
A markup on every message. Charges for sends that failed. Retries, billed twice. Even messages to people who said stop.
Spandan reserves at launch, and settles on completion. Opted-out numbers are skipped. Retries are never charged twice. And anything that never went out, comes back to your wallet.
And every message is billed at Meta's own rate. Zero markup.
Ever been surprised by a messaging bill? Comment yes, or no.
